mapper.select: SELECT price FROM PRODUCT WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS (ORDER_ID, MEMBER_ID, TOTAL_PRICE, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (ORDERS_SEQ.nextval, #{memberId}, #{totalPrice}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEMS (ORDER_ITEM_ID, ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (ORDER_ITEMS_SEQ.nextval, #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{price})
INSERT INTO PAYMENTS(PAYMENT_ID, ORDER_ID, PAYMENT_METHOD, AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (PAYMENTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{orderId}, #{paymentMethod}, #{amount}, 'READY', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.price, oi.quantity, p.product_name, p.image_url, (oi.price * oi.quantity) AS totalPrice FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT recipient_name, recipient_phone, zip_code, base_address, detail_address FROM MEMBER_ADDRESS WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENTS SET PAYMENT_METHOD = #{paymentMethod}, STATUS = #{status}, PAID_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT order_item_id AS orderItemId, order_id AS orderId, product_id AS productId, quantity, price FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
SELECT order_id AS orderId, payment_method AS paymentMethod, amount, status, paid_at AS paidAt FROM PAYMENTS WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT p.order_id, p.payment_method, p.amount, p.status, p.paid_at FROM PAYMENTS p JOIN ORDERS o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY p.payment_id DESC
